about: Large datasets are NOT stored in git. This catalog lists where each one comes from; `npm run data:fetch -- <id>` downloads it into data/raw/<id>/ (git-ignored). Sizes were read from the servers on 2026-11-14. Add a dataset by adding an entry here.

datasets.title: Moon colour map, 4096x2048
datasets.description: LRO/LROC colour mosaic. The app's committed texture (public/textures/moon_lroc_color_4k.jpg) is a JPEG conversion of this file.
datasets.format: TIFF, equirectangular, centred on 0 deg longitude
datasets.license: Public domain (NASA). Credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio.

datasets.title: Moon colour map, 8192x4096
datasets.description: Sharper version of the colour map, for close-up views.
datasets.format: TIFF, equirectangular, centred on 0 deg longitude
datasets.license: Public domain (NASA). Credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio.

datasets.title: Global elevation, 4 px/degree (about 7.6 km per pixel)
datasets.description: LOLA elevation from the CGI Moon Kit. Small enough for quick experiments.
datasets.format: 32-bit float TIFF, equirectangular, kilometres relative to the 1737.4 km sphere
datasets.license: Public domain (NASA). Credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio.

datasets.title: Global elevation, 16 px/degree (about 1.9 km per pixel)
datasets.description: LOLA elevation from the CGI Moon Kit. Good for globe relief shading and regional slopes.
datasets.format: 32-bit float TIFF, equirectangular, kilometres relative to the 1737.4 km sphere
datasets.license: Public domain (NASA). Credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio.

datasets.title: Global elevation, 64 px/degree (about 474 m per pixel)
datasets.description: LOLA elevation from the CGI Moon Kit at its highest resolution. 1 GB.
datasets.format: 32-bit float TIFF, equirectangular, kilometres relative to the 1737.4 km sphere
datasets.license: Public domain (NASA). Credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio.

datasets.title: South pole elevation, 75S to the pole, 120 m per pixel
datasets.description: LOLA gridded elevation. Wide view of the south polar region for horizons seen from far away.
datasets.format: PDS3 image + label: 16-bit signed integers, little-endian; height in metres = value x 0.5, relative to the 1737.4 km sphere; south polar stereographic
datasets.license: Public (NASA Planetary Data System). Cite the LRO LOLA team and the PDS Geosciences Node.

datasets.title: South pole elevation, 80S to the pole, 80 m per pixel
datasets.description: LOLA gridded elevation, 7600 x 7600 pixels. First choice for slopes and horizon masks at south-pole sites.
datasets.format: PDS3 image + label: 16-bit signed integers, little-endian; height in metres = value x 0.5, relative to the 1737.4 km sphere; south polar stereographic
datasets.license: Public (NASA Planetary Data System). Cite the LRO LOLA team and the PDS Geosciences Node.

datasets.title: South pole elevation, 80S to the pole, 20 m per pixel
datasets.description: LOLA gridded elevation at 20 m. 1.8 GB.
datasets.format: PDS3 image + label: 16-bit signed integers, little-endian; height in metres = value x 0.5, relative to the 1737.4 km sphere; south polar stereographic
datasets.license: Public (NASA Planetary Data System). Cite the LRO LOLA team and the PDS Geosciences Node.

datasets.title: South pole elevation, 87.5S to the pole, 5 m per pixel
datasets.description: LOLA gridded elevation at 5 m around the pole itself. 1.8 GB.
datasets.format: PDS3 image + label: 16-bit signed integers, little-endian; height in metres = value x 0.5, relative to the 1737.4 km sphere; south polar stereographic
datasets.license: Public (NASA Planetary Data System). Cite the LRO LOLA team and the PDS Geosciences Node.
